name: undo-costs
of: A mechanism by which reversing a move incurs a cost that the move's own account does not show, named with who bears it, who discovers it and when, and what the reversal cannot restore, and sorted by when and to whom the bill is presented: written in a rule before the move and presented at the attempt, quoted at the attempt by a material, an absence, or a specialist, incurred during the reversal by what was made or watched in the interval, presented after it by a body, a counterparty, a room, an index, or a treasury, delivered to a chair the mover never sat in, or presented to no one, because the bill is a date-setter's existence and has no addressee until someone volunteers to be one.
items: Second undo is with prejudice: a rule meters reversals so that the first is free and the second costs the thing being reversed, as a plaintiff may dismiss a federal suit once by notice and a second voluntary dismissal of the same claim is an adjudication on the merits, as a retirement account may be rolled over once in twelve months and a second rollover is a taxed distribution, as the employer that takes a leaver back once reads the second leaving as the answer; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the second attempt, by the party who thought the first had been free, and it was readable in the rule before the first move by anyone who looked; the reversal cannot restore the count, since the count is what the reversal spent; not forms-of-return's Open-box refund, where the interval is priced onto the particular, since here nothing is marked and what is spent is a number kept by the rule.

Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it, and not a signed contract's ordinary bindingness, the seller's election against a buyer who repudiates, since that is the move's own paper and outside this map.

Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the unused tract has been scarring shut and the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer releases, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.

Way back rots: the reversal's precondition is held by someone or something outside the move and decays while nobody spends anything, as the old supplier's line is retooled for other customers, the two people who ran the old system leave, the part the old machine needs goes out of production, and the backup that would restore the old state has never been restored from and is found, at the attempt, to be unreadable; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, as an absence rather than a price, and it was invisible before because nothing was being paid, so a mover who wants the option must rehearse the reversal while the move stands, a small order to the old supplier, a restore drill, a retainer, and pay the rehearsal as the option's price; the reversal cannot restore the day the way back was still there; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting for the day the source dies, since here the spare is the old source itself, aging while unused, and not pivot-invariants' preservation state from which idle equipment can be recommissioned, which names the asset whose absence this bill is.

Only three shops undo it: the move is a commodity and its reversal is a specialty, so the mover bought from a hundred sellers and must undo through three, who price the reversal against the mover's need and not against their cost, as a tattoo is made by any parlor and removed by a clinic with a laser, as an integration is done by the acquirer's own staff and unpicked by the boutique that does carve-outs, as a system is installed by its vendor and torn out by the one firm that has done it before; the bill is the specialist's margin, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the quote, which comes with the number of other shops that could have given one; the reversal cannot restore the competitive price the move enjoyed, and no rehearsal makes a fourth shop, so the quote is worth getting before the move; not tollgates-that-must-buy, where the gate is compelled to buy from the passers, since here the gate stands only on the way back and sells; and not Way back rots, a capacity that was common and decayed, since this one was never common.

Writes in the interval: the move opened a period in which new things were made in the move's form, and the reversal has nowhere to put them, as a schema migration is reverted in a minute if nothing has been written and in a week if a month of rows carry a shape the old schema cannot hold, as two merged companies are separated under a transitional services agreement whose whole purpose is to keep paying for the months in which one payroll, one ledger, and one contract book were made, as a rule implemented across an industry is repealed while the filings made under it are still owed; the bill is borne by the mover and by whoever made the writes; it is discovered during the reversal, row by row, when the first thing with no old-form home is found; the reversal cannot restore a state in which the interval's products do not exist, so it must either carry them in a shape they were not made for or delete what people made in good faith; not forms-of-return's Hard reset, the return that deletes the interval and pretends it never happened, since that is the choice this bill prices, and not pivot-invariants' working state that can be restored without reconstructing its history, which names the asset whose absence this is.

Route the move revealed: the reversal must travel the way the move came, in front of a party who learned that way by watching the move, as a unit that advanced up a valley withdraws down it under guns that have since registered every bend, as a firm that entered a market through a distributor leaves through the same distributor, who now knows exactly what the firm needs in order to get out; the bill is borne by the mover, in losses on the way back that were not taken on the way out; it is discovered during the reversal, by the adversary first and by the mover second; the reversal cannot restore the route's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse goes in by a route it can afford to be seen leaving by, or holds a second route it never used to go in; not Unsayable back, where the counterparty keeps what it learned and prices it later, since here the reversal must be executed inside what was learned; and not first-mover-forecloses, which shuts the rival's options, since here the mover's own move opened its own way back to view.

Rebound above baseline: the system the move acted on adapted to the move while it stood, so the reversal lands not on the original state but on the adapted one and overshoots it, as a beta-blocker stopped abruptly produces a heart rate and a pressure above where they were before it was started, as acid suppression withdrawn after months produces more acid than the untreated stomach, as a price cut restored reads to the customer as an increase because the reference price moved to the cut and stayed there, so the seller who takes back a discount faces a demand below the one the discount was given to lift; the bill is borne by the patient, the customer, the firm; it is discovered in the days after the reversal, by whoever is inside the system, and the mover often reads the overshoot as proof the move was needed; the reversal cannot land on the baseline directly, only reach it, or a new one, by a taper, and the taper is the bill's schedule; not risk-rebound-effects' Compensated cushion, where users spend a safety margin on new risk while the protection stands, since here nothing happens until the withdrawal.

Unsayable back: the move told the counterparty something, an offer, a number, a plan, a defect in diligence, and the reversal keeps the counterparty and leaves it knowing, so the mover lives with a hearer whose knowledge no longer matches any act, as a settlement offer withdrawn stays in the opposing lawyer's head though the evidence rule keeps it out of the trial, as a layoff announced and then cancelled keeps the staff, who now know where they stood on the list, as a code base shown to an acquirer who then walks stays shown; the bill is borne by the mover, in every later dealing with the hearer; it is discovered in the next round, when the counterparty anchors on the withdrawn number or the kept employee gives notice in a better market; the reversal cannot restore ignorance, and, unlike leaving the move standing, it leaves the knowledge unmatched by an act, which the hearer prices as bad faith or as weakness; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a divisibility that kills the deal while it lives, since here the deal lives and the concession is withdrawn.

Retraction read by the room: the reversal itself is a signal the move was not, and third parties who never held a stake in the move update on it, as a recall tells the market the product is defective in a way the launch did not deny, as a tariff withdrawn under one partner's pressure teaches every other partner to press, as a term sheet pulled tells the next founder that the fund pulls, as a rate rise reversed at the next meeting tells the market that the bank does not know; the bill is borne by the mover, in dealings with parties who were not at the table; it is discovered at the next dealing, when the room prices the mover as one that reverses; the reversal cannot restore the room's prior; not walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, where a record of walks buys credibility, since here a record of un-walks spends it.

Retraction louder than the claim: the reversal is published on a wider channel than the move was, by a rule that requires the notice and not the act, as a recall must be mailed to every registered owner while the sale was a line in a dealer's book, as hiring fifty people is a line in payroll and letting fifty go is a notice to the state that a reporter reads, as a paper is published in one journal and its retraction is flagged in every index that carries the paper, whether or not a reader of the paper ever sees the flag; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered by everyone at once and by the mover last, when the next counterparty mentions what it found in a search; the reversal cannot restore the move's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse should make the move on a channel no wider than the one the reversal will be forced onto; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, since here two traces form by rule and the asymmetry between them is the bill.

Second taxable event: the reversal is a second transaction to a party that was not at the table for the first, and that party bills both legs, as selling a thing to unwind its purchase realizes the gain and pays the duty again, as a house bought and sold within a year pays duty on the way in and tax on the gain on the way out, and in several jurisdictions a surcharge for selling so soon, as a stock sold at a loss and bought back within thirty days has the loss refused and folded into the new basis, so the reversal cancels the one tax benefit the move had; the bill is borne by the mover and collected by the treasury; it is discovered at the next filing, by the accountant, months after the reversal has been done and often after the mover has spent the proceeds; the reversal cannot restore the basis, since the asset comes back with a new one; not dilution-carriers, which drain ownership by a route other than price, since here nothing drains and the two legs are simply both charged.

Hedge left naked: the move was one leg of a pair the mover built, and reversing it leaves the other leg standing as something else, as the loan repaid early leaves the swap that fixed its rate as a bet on rates, as the manager let go leaves the team hired under them as a team with no reason, as the market entered leaves the warehouse leased for it as a warehouse; the bill is borne by the mover, in the other leg's new nature and in its own reversal cost, which is a second bill of this map's kind; it is discovered when the other leg is next priced, by the treasurer who marks the swap or the director who inherits the team; the reversal cannot restore the pair, and the mover must either unwind the other leg, paying its bill, or hold it in its new nature; not risk-rebound-effects' Correlated hedge, where the hedge fails while paired, since here it is unpaired by the mover's own hand, and not Chair already given away, where the reliance is another's, since here the mover relied on itself.

Chair already given away: the counterparty acted on the move in a way it cannot take back, so the reversal restores the mover and not the counterparty, as the candidate who resigned on a signed offer finds the offer withdrawn and the old chair filled, as the carrier that positioned a vessel for a booking finds it cancelled, as the supplier that tooled for a program finds the program dropped; the bill is borne by the counterparty, and the law's answer, reliance damages, moves part of it back into the mover's account and rarely all, since the old chair is not for sale; it is discovered by the counterparty at the rescission and by the mover when the counterparty sues or when the next candidate has heard; the reversal cannot restore the counterparty's prior position; not clean-exits' Queue at the door, where exits are paced so that leaving does not hurt the stayers, since here nothing was paced and the bill lands on the one who moved for the mover.

Strangers built on it: parties the mover never counted built on the move, so the reversal's bill has no denominator, as an interface deprecated finds callers that were never registered, as a bus route cut finds a shift that was chosen for it, as a program of grants ended finds a town of small firms that hired for it; the bill is borne by the strangers, then by the mover when they surface; it is discovered after the reversal, by complaint, in a count the mover could not have made before, and the law's answer, the grandfather clause and the doctrine of legitimate expectation, is to exempt what was built and reverse only for those who have not yet built, which is the bill made explicit and paid in the reversal's incompleteness; the reversal cannot restore the strangers' builds nor the state in which no one had built; not risk-rebound-effects' Levee effect, where protection invites settlement while it stands, since here the settlement is the bill of taking the levee down, and not Chair already given away, whose reliers the mover can name and settle with.

Successor pays the write-down: the move was made by an office and the reversal is made by a later holder of it, who takes the cost without having had the move's benefit, as the chief executive who acquired has left and the one who divests takes the write-down against their own year, as the government that cut the tax has left office and the one that restores it takes the blame, as the commander who ordered the advance has rotated and the one who withdraws signs for the losses; the bill is borne by the successor, in the record of their tenure; it is discovered on taking office, in the inherited position, and the predecessor never discovers it at all; the reversal cannot restore the credit for the move to the chair that pays for reversing it; where the room grants a new holder a housecleaning window, the bill is lightest in the successor's first year and reversals cluster at the handover, the incoming chief executive's big bath, and where the room grants none, as with a tax restored or a withdrawal signed, an office whose holders rotate faster than their moves can be undone will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose; not clean-exits' Chair filled before it's empty, which conserves continuity for the firm, since here the continuity is what delivers the bill, not term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the later hand exercises a power it never signed, since here it pays for one, and not power-trades' Blame-bearer's fee, where the signature is paid to bear the blame, since the successor was never paid.

Truce needed no paper the first time: the state before the move was held up by something never written, a trust, a norm, a habit of not asking, and the move spent it, so the reversal restores the terms and must now hold them with a prop the first state did not need, as a ceasefire broken once is re-signed with monitors, as two firms that did not poach each other's staff and then did can now agree not to only in writing, which in many jurisdictions is a crime, as a couple reconciled after a leaving keeps the marriage with a counselor it did not have; the bill is borne by both parties, in the prop's cost and in the second state's visible dependence on it; it is discovered the second time, when a party notices that the terms are back and the ease is not; the reversal cannot restore the tacitness, since a thing once written cannot be unwritten back into a habit; not forms-of-return's Agamemnon's bath, where the place changed because of the absence, since here what changed is what held the place up, and not cooperation-ignitions, which asks how a first cooperation starts, since here the question is what the second one must be built on.

Coordination spent: the move was made by many hands at once, on a date that something outside the group supplied, a sovereign, a regulator, a deadline, an event, so the reversal's bill is a second such date, which no hand in the group can make for itself and which the move's account never showed because the first date came without being bought, as Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 on a date the Riksdag set against a referendum that had voted to stay left, so the date-setter and not the drivers' willingness did the work, as Okinawa, which drove on the right under American administration, moved back to the left in 1978 on a date a returning sovereign set, and as an industry that migrated to one standard at one deadline would migrate back only at a second deadline nobody is placed to set; the bill is borne by whoever wants the return, in the price of finding or becoming a date-setter, and until one exists it is presented to no one; it is discovered when someone proposes the return and finds no one against it and no one to set the date; the reversal cannot restore the focal moment, only manufacture another; the claim is speculative beyond its cases, and its honest form is that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group, so where none exists the reversal waits, not because the way back is gone but because its bill has no addressee, which is the stop where the walk ends; not Truce needed no paper the first time, where what was spent was trust and paper can replace it at a price, since here what is missing is a date and no paper replaces a date; and not market-births' preconditions, which a market builds or imports, since a group cannot import its own date-setter without becoming subject to one.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: two-dismissal rules, rollover limits, clawback consents, wire recalls, contract repudiation, banked furnaces, vasectomy reversal, retooled supplier lines, unreadable backups, schema rollbacks, transitional services agreements, beta-blocker withdrawal, reference prices, withdrawn settlement offers, cancelled layoffs, recalls, retraction flags, stamp duty on both legs, naked swaps, rescinded offers, deprecated interfaces, grandfather clauses, inherited write-downs, re-signed ceasefires, no-poach norms, a driving-side switch; drawn from litigation, tax, hiring, procurement, engineering, medicine, pricing, mergers, field withdrawals, treaties, and public administration.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Three items carry marked modality: Coordination spent marks its claim as speculative beyond its two cases, the Swedish and Okinawan switches, in both of which a sovereign set the date, and limits it to the claim that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group; Retraction louder than the claim's journal case is under test in the near priority, since retracted papers are known to go on being cited, which would mean the flag does not reach the readers; Route the move revealed's field case is analytical, drawn from the general shape of a withdrawal rather than from a named operation. Rebound above baseline's medical cases are documented pharmacology, simplified; nothing here is advice. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable critic review applied 2026-09-10
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real reversal, a divestiture, a cancelled layoff, a withdrawal, runs several of these bills at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of when and to whom the bill is presented, not a ranking of size or of blame; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, passages, conversion, and dependency they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the two-dismissal rule, the rollover limit, stamp duty, transitional services agreements, beta-blocker withdrawal, the 1967 Swedish and 1978 Okinawan driving-side switches, vasectomy reversal rates, recall and layoff notice rules) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about specific transactions, nor legal or medical advice.

Costs written into the move's own paper, termination fees, break fees, notice periods, a priced release, are outside; clean-exits carries those, and the boundary case below says what happens to an item on this map once counterparties learn to write it in. Sunk costs, what the move spent and no reversal refunds, are outside, and so is a record the move wrote that the reversal merely fails to erase; only a record the reversal itself writes, wider than the move's, is in (Retraction louder than the claim).

A way back that is gone entirely belongs to the neighbor map on option expiry; every item here has a way back that can still be bought, and Way back rots is admitted while the price is finite. forms-of-return studies what sameness licenses a return and clean-exits what a leaving conserves; this map takes only the bill for coming back.

seriation.axis: When and to whom the bill for the reversal is presented, relative to the mover's chair: from a bill written in a rule the mover could have read before moving and presented at the attempt, through bills quoted at the attempt by a material, an absence, or a specialist, bills incurred during the reversal by what was made or watched in the interval, bills presented after the reversal by a body, a counterparty, a room, an index, or a treasury, then bills delivered to the mover's own other moves and to chairs the mover never sat in, the relier, the strangers, the successor, both parties to a truce, to a bill with no addressee, a date-setter's existence, presented to no one until someone volunteers to be one.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of size or of blame. Second undo is with prejudice opens it because the meter is in a rule anyone could have read, and Coordination spent closes it because the bill has no addressee: not a bill with no payer, which would be an option expiry, but a date-setter's existence, presented to no one until someone volunteers to be one. Second key for the way back sits in the opening stretch, but its unwritten form, the beneficiary who can leave, is not readable before the move, so that item straddles the first two stops and only its written keys are readable in advance. Way back rots → Only three shops undo it is the consequential adjacency: both bill at the attempt for a capacity, but rot is a capacity that was common and decayed by nobody's spending, while the specialty is a capacity that was never common, so the operator's move differs: against rot, rehearse the reversal while the move stands and pay the rehearsal as the option's price; against the specialty, get the quote before moving, since no rehearsal makes a fourth shop. Retraction louder than the claim → Second taxable event is where the presenter stops being a watcher and becomes a party that was never at the table and has a rule for both legs. Hedge left naked → Chair already given away is the turn from bills to the mover's own other moves to bills delivered to other chairs; from there the walk leaves the mover: the relier, the strangers, the successor, both parties to a truce, and at the end a group. Two stops are placed by when rather than by whom: Writes in the interval and Route the move revealed bill during the reversal itself, between the quote and the aftermath, which is why they sit between the attempt and the next dealing.

relations.label: If the way back is found rotten at the attempt and the mover will not pay to refill the absence, the move is left standing, and while it stands the move sets, so a reversal balked at rot is quoted later as a demolition; where the mover pays for the absence at once, the loop never starts.

relations.to: Way back rots: the reversal's precondition is held by someone or something outside the move and decays while nobody spends anything, as the old supplier's line is retooled for other customers, the two people who ran the old system leave, the part the old machine needs goes out of production, and the backup that would restore the old state has never been restored from and is found, at the attempt, to be unreadable; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, as an absence rather than a price, and it was invisible before because nothing was being paid, so a mover who wants the option must rehearse the reversal while the move stands, a small order to the old supplier, a restore drill, a retainer, and pay the rehearsal as the option's price; the reversal cannot restore the day the way back was still there; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting for the day the source dies, since here the spare is the old source itself, aging while unused, and not pivot-invariants' preservation state from which idle equipment can be recommissioned, which names the asset whose absence this bill is.
relations.label: If the set move is quoted at a demolition the mover will not pay, the move stands longer still, and the way back rots further while it does, so the two bills compound through the mover's postponement and a reversal not made early is made at a price both have raised.

relations.from: Successor pays the write-down: the move was made by an office and the reversal is made by a later holder of it, who takes the cost without having had the move's benefit, as the chief executive who acquired has left and the one who divests takes the write-down against their own year, as the government that cut the tax has left office and the one that restores it takes the blame, as the commander who ordered the advance has rotated and the one who withdraws signs for the losses; the bill is borne by the successor, in the record of their tenure; it is discovered on taking office, in the inherited position, and the predecessor never discovers it at all; the reversal cannot restore the credit for the move to the chair that pays for reversing it; where the room grants a new holder a housecleaning window, the bill is lightest in the successor's first year and reversals cluster at the handover, the incoming chief executive's big bath, and where the room grants none, as with a tax restored or a withdrawal signed, an office whose holders rotate faster than their moves can be undone will make moves and not unmake them, and the reversals wait for a holder with nothing to lose; not clean-exits' Chair filled before it's empty, which conserves continuity for the firm, since here the continuity is what delivers the bill, not term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the later hand exercises a power it never signed, since here it pays for one, and not power-trades' Blame-bearer's fee, where the signature is paid to bear the blame, since the successor was never paid.
relations.to: Retraction read by the room: the reversal itself is a signal the move was not, and third parties who never held a stake in the move update on it, as a recall tells the market the product is defective in a way the launch did not deny, as a tariff withdrawn under one partner's pressure teaches every other partner to press, as a term sheet pulled tells the next founder that the fund pulls, as a rate rise reversed at the next meeting tells the market that the bank does not know; the bill is borne by the mover, in dealings with parties who were not at the table; it is discovered at the next dealing, when the room prices the mover as one that reverses; the reversal cannot restore the room's prior; not walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, where a record of walks buys credibility, since here a record of un-walks spends it.
relations.label: If the reversal is made by a successor, the room reads it as housecleaning and charges the confession to the predecessor already gone, so the successor takes the write-down without the reputation bill; where the same hand reverses, or the successor was the mover's deputy, the write-down is read as the confession and both bills land on one chair.

relations.from: Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it, and not a signed contract's ordinary bindingness, the seller's election against a buyer who repudiates, since that is the move's own paper and outside this map.
relations.to: Coordination spent: the move was made by many hands at once, on a date that something outside the group supplied, a sovereign, a regulator, a deadline, an event, so the reversal's bill is a second such date, which no hand in the group can make for itself and which the move's account never showed because the first date came without being bought, as Sweden's drivers moved to the right on one Sunday in 1967 on a date the Riksdag set against a referendum that had voted to stay left, so the date-setter and not the drivers' willingness did the work, as Okinawa, which drove on the right under American administration, moved back to the left in 1978 on a date a returning sovereign set, and as an industry that migrated to one standard at one deadline would migrate back only at a second deadline nobody is placed to set; the bill is borne by whoever wants the return, in the price of finding or becoming a date-setter, and until one exists it is presented to no one; it is discovered when someone proposes the return and finds no one against it and no one to set the date; the reversal cannot restore the focal moment, only manufacture another; the claim is speculative beyond its cases, and its honest form is that the second coordination needs a date-setter from outside the group, so where none exists the reversal waits, not because the way back is gone but because its bill has no addressee, which is the stop where the walk ends; not Truce needed no paper the first time, where what was spent was trust and paper can replace it at a price, since here what is missing is a date and no paper replaces a date; and not market-births' preconditions, which a market builds or imports, since a group cannot import its own date-setter without becoming subject to one.
relations.label: If the second key is held by everyone who made the move together, no holder can sell it and no holder can be bought hand by hand, so a consent that could be priced becomes a date that must bind all hands at once, which only a date-setter outside the group can supply; where one hand holds the key, it is still for sale.

relations.from: Truce needed no paper the first time: the state before the move was held up by something never written, a trust, a norm, a habit of not asking, and the move spent it, so the reversal restores the terms and must now hold them with a prop the first state did not need, as a ceasefire broken once is re-signed with monitors, as two firms that did not poach each other's staff and then did can now agree not to only in writing, which in many jurisdictions is a crime, as a couple reconciled after a leaving keeps the marriage with a counselor it did not have; the bill is borne by both parties, in the prop's cost and in the second state's visible dependence on it; it is discovered the second time, when a party notices that the terms are back and the ease is not; the reversal cannot restore the tacitness, since a thing once written cannot be unwritten back into a habit; not forms-of-return's Agamemnon's bath, where the place changed because of the absence, since here what changed is what held the place up, and not cooperation-ignitions, which asks how a first cooperation starts, since here the question is what the second one must be built on.
relations.to: Second key for the way back: the move needed one assent and the reversal needs a second that the move did not, as a raise given by a manager's signature is taken back, in much of Europe, only with the employee's consent or through a procedure the law sets, as a grant approved by a board is clawed back, absent a clawback clause written before the grant, only with the grantee's signature, as a wire sent on the payer's instruction alone is recalled only if the receiving bank and its customer agree, and, in the unwritten form, as a perk given to a team is taken back only past the party the giving created, which holds the key by being able to leave; the bill is the second key's price and its delay, borne by the mover; it is discovered at the attempt, when the mover reaches for a hand that is not its own, and the written key was readable before the move; the reversal cannot restore the one-hand state in which the move was made, since the second hand, once used, has learned that it holds a key; where the rule runs the other way, as a treaty entered by two-thirds of a senate and left, in practice, by one signature, this item has no bill and the move is the costly leg; not term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, a class vote written at signing over named states, since here the key did not exist until the move made it, and not a signed contract's ordinary bindingness, the seller's election against a buyer who repudiates, since that is the move's own paper and outside this map.
relations.label: If the second truce's paper writes a term the other party must release, a notice period, a consent to vary, a monitor's sign-off, then that party holds a key over any third move that the first truce's habit did not give it, and a reversal of this kind manufactures the next reversal's bill; where the paper writes only a remedy or a witness, as a monitored ceasefire or a counseled marriage does, a third move is a breach with a claim against it and no key, and the dependency does not run.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does reversing a move cost something that the move's own account does not show, and where is that cost kept?
exploration.changed_question: To whom is the bill delivered, and can it be delivered to nobody: is there a reversal whose cost is paid in a capacity that no one's ledger carries, and who, if anyone, is in the business of collecting the bill for a way back? Breath one assumed the bill is presented to the mover, sooner or later, by a rule, a material, an absence, a body, a counterparty, a room, or a treasury; pressing on Chair already given away and Second taxable event showed bills delivered to chairs the mover never sits in and from parties who never sat at the table, pressing on Unsayable back showed a reversal that must be executed inside what the move revealed rather than merely priced by it afterward, and pressing on Way back rots asked who profits from the way back being narrow, which turned the question from where the bill is kept to who can be handed it at all.

priorities.item: Retraction louder than the claim: the reversal is published on a wider channel than the move was, by a rule that requires the notice and not the act, as a recall must be mailed to every registered owner while the sale was a line in a dealer's book, as hiring fifty people is a line in payroll and letting fifty go is a notice to the state that a reporter reads, as a paper is published in one journal and its retraction is flagged in every index that carries the paper, whether or not a reader of the paper ever sees the flag; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered by everyone at once and by the mover last, when the next counterparty mentions what it found in a search; the reversal cannot restore the move's obscurity, so a mover who expects to reverse should make the move on a channel no wider than the one the reversal will be forced onto; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, since here two traces form by rule and the asymmetry between them is the bill.
priorities.why: Its carrier is public: retraction databases and citation indexes exist, recall notices are mandated and counted, and layoff notices to the state are filed, so the claim that the reversal's record travels wider than the move's can be checked without anyone's cooperation, and one of its three cases is already doubtful, since retracted papers are known to go on being cited.
priorities.next_question: For a set of retracted papers, compare the reach of the paper before retraction with the reach of the flag after it, citations that mention the retraction against citations that do not; if most later citations ignore the flag, the journal case fails and the item keeps only the cases where the rule forces the notice into the reader's hands, the recall and the layoff notice, and the item's mechanism narrows from 'a wider channel' to 'a channel that reaches the counterparty's next search'.

priorities.why: Low confidence that the return's bill is a date-setter's existence rather than merely a higher price for the next coordination, since both cases, Sweden and Okinawa, had a sovereign to set the date and the item is marked speculative beyond them; high generative promise, because if it holds, the map's last stop is a bill with no addressee and the same shape should appear wherever a group moved on a focal date, standards, calendars, currencies, and the operator's question becomes whether a date-setter exists before the move is made rather than after.
priorities.next_question: Collect every coordinated switch made on a single date by a whole jurisdiction or industry, driving side, calendar, currency, measurement system, a wire protocol, and ask for each whether a return was ever proposed, whether anyone was against it, and whether a date was ever set; if returns were proposed and died for want of a date-setter rather than for opposition, the item holds; if returns happened wherever an outside authority could set the date and nowhere else, its speculative marking can be dropped; and if a group ever set the return date for itself, the item fails and the bill was only a price.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing six items (recasting Coordination spent from a bill with no payer, an option expiry by the map's own fence, into the bill of a manufactured focal date; reconciling Successor pays the write-down with its own edge by naming the housecleaning window; dropping the repudiated-contract and Roth-recharacterization cases as the move's own paper and a way back removed; correcting the rebound and vasectomy mechanism clauses) and relabeling three edges so the loop starts at the attempt and the two passages hold as conditionals; no item restates clean-exits or forms-of-return.

neighbors.right: Set like plaster: the moved thing hardens by a process of its own that ran while the move stood, so the reversal's bill is a demolition sized by elapsed time, as a blast furnace banked hot is brought back in days and one let go cold cracks its lining and is relined at the cost of a rebuild, as a vasectomy reversed within a few years usually restores fertility and reversed after fifteen does so less often, since the unused tract has been scarring shut and the body has been making antibodies against what it no longer releases, as a temporary reporting line that stood a year is the organization and is reversed as a reorganization; the bill is borne by the mover; it is discovered when the quote for the way back comes in, and the quote's size is the date, so a mover who reads it learns how long the move stood; the reversal cannot restore the wet state, only produce a second setting; not lead-time-floors' Gestation, a replacement that must grow, since here it is the move that grew and the growing is the bill.
neighbors.separating_case: A firm moved off its old planning system two years ago and wants it back. Bring back the old vendor on a retainer and rehire the two people who ran it: if the old system now runs and the business can use it, the bill was rot, an absence held outside the move that money and time can refill; if the old system runs and the business no longer fits it, because two years of orders, roles, and habits were shaped to the new one, the bill was plaster, a hardening in the moved thing itself that no supplier can reverse. The two bills are told apart by what a rehearsal would have bought: a restore drill a year ago would have caught rot and would have done nothing about the setting.

checks.boundary_case: The early-termination fee, the break fee, the notice period, a reversal cost written into the move's own paper and priced at signing, is a tempting nonmember and is out: the fee is held in the move's own account, known to both hands before the move, and it is what clean-exits' priced release conserves. The ruling draws the map's fence: every item here is a bill that the move's paper does not carry, and the fee is what one of these bills becomes once a counterparty has been reversed on often enough to write it in, so the vendor who has been cancelled charges setup, the landlord who has been walked out on takes a deposit, and a bill that was Chair already given away migrates into the entry price and leaves the map. A second fence sits on the other side: sunk cost, the money the move spent that no reversal refunds, is out, since it is the move's bill and not the reversal's, and so is a record the move wrote that the reversal merely fails to erase, which is why the withdrawn suit's docket entry was refused and only the reversal's own louder notice was admitted.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: from Chair already given away, whether the mover can count its reliers decides whether the bill can be settled before the reversal, by reliance damages or a negotiated release, or arrives afterward without a denominator as Strangers built on it, so two items adjacent on the walk are one question apart in practice. It shows a loop, Way back rots → Set like plaster → Way back rots, carried by the mover's postponement: a way back found rotten at the attempt makes a mover who will not pay to refill the absence keep the move standing, during which the move sets, and the set move is quoted at a demolition that makes the mover keep it standing longer, during which the way back rots further, so a reversal not made early is made at a bill both processes have compounded. It shows a passage between levels at Chair already given away → Second key for the way back, where a bill in the counterparty's ledger becomes a key in its hand once the law or the paper gives the relier a say, and a second passage at Second key for the way back → Coordination spent, where a key held by everyone who moved together cannot be bought hand by hand and becomes a date that must bind all hands at once, which only a date-setter outside the group can supply, so the walk's second stop and its last are one condition apart. It shows a conversion at Successor pays the write-down → Retraction read by the room: the same reversal bills the successor's year or the mover's reputation depending on whose hand holds the pen, and cannot bill both. And it shows a dependency at Truce needed no paper the first time → Second key for the way back, which runs only where the second truce's paper writes a term the other party must release, since that paper is then a key over any third move and a reversal of this kind manufactures the next reversal's bill; where the paper writes only a remedy or a witness, the dependency does not run.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-10), not by a self-read: the target is preserved. The critic found each item a distinct mechanism naming who bears the bill, who discovers it and when, and what the reversal cannot restore, and found no item restating clean-exits or forms-of-return; the one out-of-type member, Coordination spent as a bill with no payer, which the map's own fifth fence assigns to option-expiries, was recast as the bill of a manufactured focal date rather than cut, so the walk keeps its strange last stop; the critic's own neighbor test separated Retraction read by the room from Retraction louder than the claim by whether the reader saw both legs or only the reversal, and its boundary case refused the rollback that improves on the way back as a new move's cost hidden in the reversal's invoice. The author's own attempts to collapse Way back rots into Set like plaster and Retraction louder than the claim into Retraction read by the room stand, as do the refusals of Docket keeps the filing and Exception cited back.
